rows.text: The party's 2009 election schedule, as of 平成２１年９月２１日, lists the Diet-member vote and count with the count of the member ballots at 14:00 on ９月２８日（月） followed by the joint plenary meeting in place of a party convention, and ９月３０日（水） 総裁の任期満了日 (the day the president's term expires).
